text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Chiyooo! I read through the notebook
you gave
me!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It was chock-full of hip and young
sayings—I
loved it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I've been trying to study "cutting-edge"
language,
as you call it. Were there any
mistakes I made?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Nope, that notebook was the bomb!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Too many chill pills and you'll
accomplish nil."
"Make your move while
you're in the groove."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
All of these sayings are rad, fly, and
kickin'!
They're just like you,
Chiyo—totally tubular! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: No, thank you for this wonderful birthday present, Chiyo. ♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
You're welcome... I'm just glad you really
like it!
